label: Read paper summary batch
description: Inspect or prepare the paper, or read one fixed batch of up to 10 pages or 10 chunks for the single-agent summary workflow. At most five content batches may be read, limiting summary coverage to 50 pages or 50 chunks.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local document ID being summarized.
parameter_descriptions.action: Inspect metadata/readability, prepare unreadable extraction, or read a pages/chunks batch.
parameter_descriptions.start: For pages, the one-based starting page; for chunks, the zero-based starting chunk. Use null for inspect or prepare.
